newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 919 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 919 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totaled 919 contracts, compared with 388 contracts traded overnight Tuesday.
There were 37 wheat, 379 corn, 461 soybean, 33 soymeal, five soyoil, one corn call and three corn puts traded.
In overnight trading, corn was 1/2 cent lower to 1/4 higher, soybeans 1/4 to 2-1/4 cents higher and wheat steady to 3/4 cent lower.
